seo.title: Changelog
seo.description: See what's new in Flowtali — product updates, new features, and improvements.

title: Changelog
subtitle: New features, improvements, and fixes — in chronological order.

entries.r20_1: Flowtali AI — a built-in AI assistant, available from the new "Flowtali AI" item in the sidebar. Ask questions and get things done in plain language, in any of Flowtali's supported languages.
entries.r20_2: Bring your own AI key — connect your own Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI, or Google Gemini API key under Settings → AI. Your key is encrypted at rest and used only for your organization; Flowtali never sees or shares it.
entries.r20_3: Ask about your business — the assistant can look up your invoices, revenue and outstanding balances, receivables aging, clients, projects, receipts, letterheads, team members, recent activity, and your subscription, then answer with the real numbers.
entries.r20_4: Take action from chat — draft invoices, add and update clients, generate receipts, create shareable invoice links, mark invoices paid, email payment reminders, and more. Every action shows a clear confirmation dialog before anything runs, and destructive actions are flagged.
entries.r20_5: Saved chat history — your conversations are saved to a sidebar (like your favourite AI apps) so you can pick up where you left off. Start a new chat anytime; chats are kept for 2 weeks, then cleared automatically.
entries.r20_6: Permission-aware — the assistant only sees and does what your role allows, and every action it performs is recorded in your organization's audit log.
entries.r20_7: Replies include clickable links straight to the invoices and records referenced, and answer in your selected language.
entries.r19_1: Multilanguage support — Flowtali is now available in English, Czech, German, and French. Switch languages from the header menu, and your preference follows you across every device.
entries.r19_2: Localized public pages — the landing, Embed SDK docs, and legal pages are served at language-specific URLs (/de/, /cs/, /fr/) with hreflang alternates so search engines index the right version.
entries.r19_3: The entire logged-in app is fully translated — dashboard, invoices, receipts, letterheads, clients, projects, members, roles, organization preferences, audit logs, analytics, billing, settings, and profile.
entries.r19_4: The in-app feedback panel is now fully translated across all supported languages.
entries.r19_5: Dates and numbers throughout the app now format according to your selected language.
entries.r18_1: Complete design system overhaul — migrated the entire frontend to a Geist-based dark theme inspired by Vercel's design system, with a new green accent palette replacing the previous amber/charcoal scheme.
entries.r18_2: Geist Sans and Geist Mono variable fonts — self-hosted for faster loading and a sharper, more professional typographic feel across the entire app.
entries.r18_3: Design reference document (DESIGN.md) — a comprehensive design system guide covering colors, typography, spacing, radii, shadows, motion, components, and content voice guidelines.
entries.r18_4: Standardised 10-step color scale for grays, green accent, red (errors), amber (warnings), and blue (info) — every color token now encodes intent, not just lightness.
entries.r18_5: All buttons, inputs, toggles, tables, badges, and navigation components rebuilt with consistent Geist tokens — flat design, no gradients, subtle shadows.
entries.r18_6: Global focus ring updated to a two-layer green ring for better accessibility across all interactive elements.
entries.r18_7: Reduced motion support — all animations now respect the prefers-reduced-motion media query.
entries.r18_8: Landing page hero, features, pricing, testimonials, and FAQ sections updated with the new green accent and cleaner typography.
entries.r18_9: All legal pages (About, Privacy, Terms, Contact, Changelog) and public document views updated to the new design system.
entries.r17_1: First-login welcome modal — new users are greeted with a "Take a tour" prompt on their first sign-in, with the option to skip.
entries.r17_2: Interactive tour guide — a step-by-step spotlight walkthrough covers key features; steps are automatically tailored to personal vs. organisation accounts.
entries.r17_3: Mobile bottom navigation — a persistent bottom nav bar on mobile with quick access to Home, Invoices, Clients, and a FAB shortcut to create a new invoice. A slide-up "More" sheet provides access to all other sections.
entries.r17_4: Invoices, receipts, clients, and members list views now render mobile-optimised card layouts with inline quick-actions instead of desktop-only tables.
entries.r17_5: Invoice, receipt, and letterhead editors now adapt to mobile: the form panel expands to full width, and a new eye-icon "Preview" tab lets you switch to the live document preview without leaving the editor.
entries.r17_6: Action button rows on invoice, receipt, and letterhead view pages collapse to icon-only buttons on mobile to prevent overflow, with tooltips preserving discoverability.
entries.r17_7: Invoice and receipt document previews on view pages are now horizontally scrollable on mobile — previously the right-hand columns (Rate, Amount) were clipped with no way to reach them.
entries.r16_1: API Keys section in Organization Preferences is now hidden for personal accounts — it is only relevant to organization accounts.
entries.r16_2: Stamp selector buttons in the invoice and letterhead editors no longer appear empty — resolved a data normalization issue where stamps saved in a legacy format were not converted before being sent to the frontend.
entries.r16_3: Google sign-up profile picture is now correctly downloaded and stored in our own storage on account creation — previously the Google-hosted URL was stored directly, causing broken avatar images.
entries.r16_4: Feedback panel now anchors to the bottom-right corner on desktop instead of the centre-right.
entries.r15_1: Embed SDK — embed any Flowtali view (invoices, projects, receipts, preferences and more) directly in your own product or website using a lightweight JavaScript SDK.
entries.r15_2: API key management — generate publishable and secret key pairs per organization to authenticate embedded sessions.
entries.r15_3: Embed token generation — issue short-lived, permission-scoped JWTs for your users so the embedded view auto-authenticates without a separate login.
entries.r15_4: Runtime theming — customize the embed appearance (primary color, background, font, border radius) by passing an appearance object to the SDK.
entries.r15_5: Embed event callbacks — listen for invoice.created, project.created, receipt.created and more from the parent page via ft.on().
entries.r15_6: Fixed search icon overlapping placeholder text in all search bar instances across the app.
entries.r14_1: Multi-role assignment — members can now hold more than one role per organization.
entries.r14_2: Tax type configuration — choose between percentage or flat-amount tax on invoices.
entries.r14_3: Invoice quick-fill profiles in Preferences — save sender details to auto-populate new invoices.
entries.r14_4: Bank account management — store and reuse payment details across invoices.
entries.r14_5: Stamp field in Preferences — add a custom text stamp that appears on your documents.
entries.r14_6: Permission matrix UI redesigned for clarity when managing roles.
entries.r14_7: Fixed an issue where invite emails occasionally landed in spam due to incorrect sender headers.
entries.r13_1: Two-factor authentication (2FA) — enable TOTP-based MFA from your security settings.
entries.r13_2: Dashboard analytics — live charts for invoice volume, revenue, and outstanding balances.
entries.r13_3: Recent invoices panel on the dashboard for quick access to your latest documents.
entries.r13_4: Invoice status chart — visual breakdown of paid, pending, and overdue invoices.
entries.r13_5: Dashboard now loads 40% faster due to parallelised API requests.
entries.r13_6: Fixed date formatting inconsistency on invoices when the system locale is non-English.
entries.r12_1: Receipt generator — create and share professional payment receipts.
entries.r12_2: Client management — store and reuse client details scoped to your organization.
entries.r12_3: Role-based access control — create custom roles with fine-grained permissions.
entries.r12_4: Audit log — view a full history of actions taken within your organization.
entries.r12_5: Public share pages now render faster and include Open Graph metadata for link previews.
entries.r12_6: Resolved a PDF export bug that caused signatures to appear blurred on retina displays.
entries.r11_1: Letterhead generator — create branded letterheads with live preview and PDF export.
entries.r11_2: Six letterhead themes to choose from at launch.
entries.r11_3: Share links with optional access codes for private document sharing.
entries.r11_4: Member invitations — invite teammates to your organization by email.
entries.r11_5: Invoice editor redesigned with a cleaner layout and inline line-item editing.
entries.r11_6: Fixed currency symbol placement for RTL currencies.
entries.r10_1: Invoice generator — create professional invoices with real-time preview.
entries.r10_2: Organization accounts — manage your team and documents in one workspace.
entries.r10_4: 11+ currencies supported out of the box.
entries.r10_5: Subscription billing with free and paid tiers.
